action.name: Crush
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way.

While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on its attack rolls. Its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it moves with the target.

A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

action.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
entries: Magical {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52} fills a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains {@status Concentration|SRD52} on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

entries.name: Darkmantle
entries: Unnatural subterranean hunters, darkmantles veil themselves in magical shadows and use their bizarre anatomies to disguise themselves as stalactites. When prey passes below, lurking darkmantles drop and unfurl their webbed tentacles, attempting to blind, suffocate, or crush their victims.

Darkmantles share similarities with piercers and ropers and often hunt near those monsters. Scholars have attempted to establish a shared origin or life cycle between those creatures, but their efforts are thwarted by those monsters' supernatural physiologies and deadly natures.
Just assume there's no such thing as a stalactite.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.
